Hi Jamie / Raj —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap from our side and a few technical questions so we can scope the architecture and routing policy for the pilot:

Summary from call:
- Use case: clinical search + question-answering inside clinician workflow (EMR plugin).
- Required features: low-latency generation for short responses, embeddings for semantic search, reranker for answer precision, structured output + tool calling for external DB lookups.
- Compliance: Cascade needs HIPAA controls, VPC/private control plane strongly preferred.
- Cost sensitivity: pilot needs to stay within budget targets (approx $Xk/month).

Questions for scoping (please reply inline if easier):
1) Auth & onboarding: do you want OAuth (SSO) for end-users + token exchange, or a server-to-server API key model for the integration? Any internal SSO provider constraints?
2) Embeddings: retention policy — how long can embeddings live (30/90/365 days)? Will storing embeddings in a managed vector DB be acceptable?
3) Latency SLOs: what p50/p95 targets are acceptable for interactive flows? (We typically target p95 < 250–300ms for short responses on Dedicated).
4) Fallbacks: if we need to degrade for cost/latency, is a shorter-sequence cheaper model acceptable, or do we need functional parity?
5) Region routing: do you require data to stay in a given region (US-East/West)? Any preference for primary/secondary failover regions?

Proposed next steps:
- Technical deep-dive with engineering (60–90m) to walk through SDK setup, auth flows, and routing policy options.
- Action owners: we can send a short internal plan (routing + fallback suggestions) before the call.

I attached a brief outline (cascade_ma_outline.pdf) showing integration touchpoints. Can you answer the five questions above and share preferred times for a technical deep-dive? Our team is available Mon/Tue next week (PST morning).

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

> Q1 (Auth & onboarding): Server-to-server API keys for backend-to-backend calls are fine for the pilot. For clinician SSO, we use Okta; we prefer an OAuth flow so tokens map to clinician IDs for auditing. If you can support an OAuth token-exchange pattern (Okta -> Redwood token), that would be ideal.
>
> Q2 (Embeddings): We need to retain embeddings for at least 180 days for auditability. Managed vector DB is acceptable; we are evaluating Pinecone and internal Postgres+pgvector.
>
> Q3 (Latency SLOs): p50 < 120ms and p95 < 350ms for the interactive plugin would be our goal. Batch reranking can be higher-latency.
>
> Q4 (Fallbacks): For clinician-facing answers we need to preserve answer quality; a lower-cost model is acceptable only as a last-resort with a visible indicator in the UI.
>
> Q5 (Region): All PHI must remain in US data centers. Primary: us-east-1; secondary: us-west-2.
>
> We also have an internal security contact (Raj Patel) and will need a SOC2 + data flow diagram before pilot kickoff. Happy to schedule the tech deep-dive — Mon 24th 9:30–11am PST works for our engineering team.
